title: OLEANDER Interior Design Development Process v1.0 - Candidate
purpose: Develop interior environments as real occupied, furnished, material, serviced and maintainable systems rather than decorative fit-out layers.
scope_in: interior brief, activity and room-use translation
space planning, thresholds, circulation and privacy
FF&E, equipment, storage and ergonomic fit
material/finish/CMF selection with performance and failure reasoning
samples, mockups, specifications, procurement and substitutions
installation/site review, defects, handover and in-use learning
scope_out: manufacturer marketing claims as automatic material proof
cost certainty, statutory approval or construction completion
authority_position: CANDIDATE R-E professional-domain process under the existing Professional Domain Process Contract. It is not Current until the existing Evolution, independent review, authorized human adoption and Current readback chain closes; Current architecture must continue to report Interior Design PROCESS_OPEN meanwhile.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on Interior Design professional judgment across one or more of: Interior Brief, Activity and Room-use Basis, Space Planning, Circulation, Thresholds and Privacy, FF&E, Equipment, Storage and Ergonomic Fit, Material, Finish and CMF Performance Development, Interior Assemblies, Ceilings, Partitions, Joinery and Details, Sensory, Lighting, Acoustic and Environmental Integration, Wet, Hygienic, High-wear and Specialist Interior Conditions, Samples, Mockups, Specification and Procurement Control, Installation, Site Review, Defect and Substitution Readback, Handover, Maintenance, Post-occupancy and Change.

trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable Current ceiling across project/source authority, native geometry/material/environment/configuration, specialist interfaces, actual readback and external approval governs the Interior Design claim.
not_triggered_when: the artifact merely depicts Interior Design content but makes no material professional Interior Design claim

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential Interior Design methods, material/environment/site/product evidence and specialist facts must pass existing task/claim Operational Mount rules; candidate support extensions and project observations do not self-promote to Current Knowledge.
required_methods: Current OLEANDER Design Quality/DD and Architecture room-use evidence
Current Human Factors / accessibility evidence where triggered
Current material/failure, durability, cleaning and manufacturer technical evidence
Current acoustic, lighting, MEP, fire and specialist criteria through their proper owners
source_routes: Current applicable professional/specialist standards and evidence
Current supplier/manufacturer/project field evidence where material
standard_code_routes: Current applicable standards/codes/guides via proper authority; no fixed number copied into this process becomes universal OLEANDER truth

practice_routes: Current OLEANDER Interior Design related project/failure evidence where provenance exists

stages.stage_name: Interior Brief, Activity and Room-use Basis

stage_body_contract.title_rule: <project> | INT-00 Interior Brief, Activity and Room-use Basis | <decision / cycle / tested configuration>; generic-only titles are invalid.
stage_body_contract.knowledge_mount_rule: Use the stage knowledge_mount_requirement plus the Current task/claim-scoped Operational Mount; candidate support extensions remain bounded support and canonical knowledge bodies are not copied.
stage_body_contract.native_source_rule: Bind the stage body to required_native_outputs[] and actual editable/native professional source; renders, screenshots, schedules or prose cannot replace geometry, calculation, sample, mockup, field or runtime evidence required by the claim.
